ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the entire visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and sporadic interior scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray to black pigmentation across both lobes; small, discrete circular high-contrast white blobs (scars) are scattered in the mid-section; dense white/cream cluster at the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the central axis, characterized by a wide angle and shallow depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; serrations appear more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-convex curvature extending symmetrically from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white scars (rosettes) distributed across the dark surface of both lobes, particularly visible on the left lobe and near the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of calcified, high-intensity material (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white encrustation cluster on the right lobe tip that alters the expected smooth geometric termination of the lobe.
